summary: Sprint 4 drag-and-drop and optimistic-update behavior is not implemented; existing authentication regression tests still pass.

messages.content: QA found Sprint 4 is incomplete: static/index.html has no draggable elements or drag/drop handlers. Status movement uses a select control, and mutate() waits for PATCH then reloads, so it is not optimistic.

blockers: No frontend implementation task exists for Sprint 4, so the requested drag-and-drop and optimistic UI behavior cannot be validated.
decisions: Evidence: static/index.html contains no drag, drop, dragstart, dragover, draggable, or optimistic implementation; status updates await the API before reloading.
